GDB Sunday Roll

Dallas, TX · Preston Royal · Road

No-drop

GDB Sunday Roll is a road group ride in Dallas, TX. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Northwest corner of Preston and Royal, Princi Italia lot (Preston Royal Village). About 30–35 miles, 13–14 mph average. No-drop.

For visitors

Not for beginners. You need to hold a 15–16 mph flat cruising pace to keep the group together. RSVP on the club's Meetup page.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the GDB Sunday Roll group ride

An 'Explore Dallas' Sunday ride with a new route every week, 30 to 35 miles at 13 to 14 mph. No drops intended, but the host says it is not for beginners and you should hold 15 to 16 mph on the flat. Lunch at a local restaurant afterward if you want it.
